sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original painted fantasy strategy-game hero portrait master, portrait 58:64 aspect ratio, no border or text. Subject: Pantheon / Atreus of Mount Targon, recognizable rugged mortal Rakkor spear-warrior; tanned weathered face, strong square nose, short dark beard, serious humane tired eyes, worn dark bronze Corinthian helmet pushed up so eyes and face remain visible, faded deep blue wool cloak, bronze shoulder edge. Tight close-up from upper chest, face fills most of the portrait and occupies central upper 70%, slight three-quarter turn to viewer's right. Background: individually painted ochre mountain pass, distant pale cliff and tiny storm-lit blue sky, richly varied but quiet. Style: 1999 Heroes of Might and Magic III original hero portraits, hand-painted realistic miniature oil illustration, sculpted face planes, lively subdued color, hard readable light and shadow, warm key light upper left, matte metal and coarse wool, deliberately economical broad brush shapes for legibility at58x64 pixels. Native production intention: downsample this new art to58x64 and face crop48x32, so large eyes/nose/mouth shapes and strongly separate head/background values. Entire helmet/head inside frame with modest headroom, shoulders reach bottom corners. Original composition, no tracing or copying any existing splash or portrait. Avoid modern splash-art camera, anime, photoreal photograph, plastic 3D, tiny full body, glowing eyes, neon aura, text, UI frame, signature, watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL fantasy strategy-game portrait master, portrait58:64 aspect, no text/frame. Style: original1999 Heroes of Might and Magic III hero portraits, hand-painted realistic miniature oil illustration, broad readable brush forms, expressive sculpted face planes, tactile matte armor/cloth, warm natural upper-left key light, rich varied subdued background, emphatic readable eyes/nose/mouth at58x64 and48x32. Tight head-and-upper-chest close-up; entire head inside canvas, shoulders to bottom corners, face fills central upper70%; not a bust standing far away. New original composition, never trace or copy Riot splash pixels. Avoid anime, glamour photo, plastic3D, neon, enormous glow, splash-art camera, UI, labels, watermark. Subject: Leona, adult Solari warrior of Mount Targon, strong mature fair-to-olive face, brown eyes, stern compassionate expression, thick auburn-red hair framing her jaw, restrained golden sun-shaped diadem, beautifully worn bronze-gold plate gorget and red-brown wool. Head slightly turned viewer's left, one cheek in warm amber sun, other in deep burgundy shadow. Background: ochre marble Solari temple doorway with small turquoise dusk valley beyond. Distinct face and powerful brows, recognizable auburn Leona, not a blonde princess. Modest practical neckline and shoulder armor.

Fitted charcoal blue steel high gorget and restrained crescent-shaped silver plate edge. Three-quarter face toward viewer's right, severe contemplative expression, no evil caricature. Moonlight is a subtle rim only; pale face and white hair remain readable against midnight stone. Not a generic elf; no pointed ears.
